partnershipPlan: Two advisors with lived knowledge of frequent ED use and a community organisation review the outcome definitions and the interpretation; case managers from each site review the abstraction guide.
socialListening: No social media listening; the health authority's patient relations summaries about ED care for frequent attenders are read for themes.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Once there was a plan, the ED stopped starting from zero with me every time.
items.implication: Read care plan flags in the files as part of exposure.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: We enrol the people who scare us most, so of course they look worse on paper.
items.implication: Keep complexity adjustment and report it plainly.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Our nurses carry twice the caseload and see people later; do not judge us by the city program.
items.implication: Match within site and report site estimates separately.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Counting visits misses the point; what I care about is that my brother is still alive.
items.implication: Keep death or ICU admission as the primary outcome.

summary: Four composite voices on being known, enrolment selection, community sites and outcomes.
